definitions.meaning: Bent down, low, lowly, humble, abject, mean, poor

quotations.old_english: And hé hnáh tó eorþan áleát wið ðæs engles
Næs hió hnáh ne tó gnéþ gifa
quotations.english: she was not mean nor too sparing of gifts

quotations.old_english: Iudas cwæþ ðæt hé wénde him trage [Kmbl. þrage] hnágre
quotations.english: Judas said that he expected for himself humiliating pain

quotations.old_english: Wéndon hie wera cwealmes þræge hnágran
quotations.english: they expected the death of men, a still worse time

quotations.old_english: Nó ic me hnágran talige ðonne Grendel hine
quotations.english: I think myself no worse man than does Grendel himself

quotations.old_english: Ful oft ic leán teohhode hnáhran rince sǽmran æt sæcce
quotations.english: full oft have I appointed reward to a warrior inferior and of less worth in battle

source_text: hnáh; adj. Bent down, low, lowly, humble, abject, mean, poor :-- And hé hnáh tó eorþan áleát wið ðæs engles adoravitque eum pronus in terram, Num. 22, 31. Næs hió hnáh ne tó gnéþ gifa she was not mean nor too sparing of gifts, Beo. Th. 3863; B. 1929. Iudas cwæþ ðæt hé wénde him trage [Kmbl. þrage] hnágre Judas said that he expected for himself humiliating pain, Elen. Kmbl. 1333; El. 668. Wéndon hie wera cwealmes þræge hnágran they expected the death of men, a still worse time, Andr. Kmbl. 3195; An. 1600. Nó ic me hnágran talige ðonne Grendel hine I think myself no worse man than does Grendel himself, Beo. Th. 1359; B. 677. Ful oft ic leán teohhode hnáhran rince sǽmran æt sæcce full oft have I appointed reward to a warrior inferior and of less worth in battle, 1909; B. 952. [Goth. hnaiws lowly, humble.]
